The secret to winning the Japan Cup: it 
was returning home to Katsuragi Ace's 
hometown. There, Katsuragi Ace would 
discover something crucial.

Through her success, the local people felt 
that there was no such thing as a 
"different world." And with it... the pure 
joy of running while looking straight 
ahead.

Japan's first victory, two powerful 
rivals—none of it matters. Just push 
forward, and forward again. That is her 
strength —the running style of an "Ace."

A victory would mark the first Japan Cup 
win for a Japanese contender. Facing her 
are formidable rivals.

However, Katsuragi Ace moves forward. With 
their cheers at her back, she heads 
straight... for the race!
